data.name: Baseet
data.gender_notes: Baseet is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘basitah’ which means ‘blessed’, ‘protected’, or ‘fortunate’. This name holds a significant place in Islamic history, as it is mentioned in various Hadiths and Sunnahs. The name Baseet carries the meaning “Blessed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baseet usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May Allah bless and protect this child.
data.etymology: Baseet belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baseet total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: باسط

in_urdu.name: باسط
